title: Summarize the excerpt from 'dmoi3-tablet' (chunk 39.3) about mathematics: We call the set of all subsets of A the power set of A , and write it P( A ) . Example 0.3.4 Let A | { 1 , 2 , 3 } . Fin
prompt: Summarize the excerpt from 'dmoi3-tablet' (chunk 39.3) about mathematics: We call the set of all subsets of A the power set of A , and write it P( A ) . Example 0.3.4 Let A | { 1 , 2 , 3 } . Fin
true_answer: We call the set of all subsets of A the power set of A , and write it P( A ) . Example 0.3.4 Let A | { 1 , 2 , 3 } . Find P( A ) . Solution . P( A ) is a set of sets, all of which are subsets of A . So P( A ) | {∅ , { 1 } , { 2 } , { 3 } , { 1 , 2 } , { 1 , 3 } , { 2 , 3 } , { 1 , 2 , 3 }} .
